core_categories: Medical Devices; Digital Health; Pulmonary Care Devices; Smart Inhaler Technologies; Remote Patient Monitoring
specialty_focus: Cognita Labs is a medical device and digital health company specializing in pulmonary care, focusing on screening, diagnosis, and management of chronic respiratory diseases like asthma and COPD. It develops portable airway testing devices, smart inhaler technologies, and digital coaching tools, and addresses remote patient monitoring and medication adherence for respiratory delivery devices.
